artworks.title: The Death of Patroclus
artworks.description: Wiertz's Patroclus falling in borrowed armour — Book 16's turn when Hector took the arms of Peleus from the plain.

artworks.title: Achilles Lamenting the Death of Patroclus
artworks.description: Ge's grief at the ships — the news Antilochus would bring, and the wrath that would end only with Hector's blood.
